prompt: Your organization is planning a data loss prevention (DLP) strategy. Which type of data loss scenario is DLP primarily designed to address?

options.text: Sensitive information shared accidentally by users during everyday work
External attackers breaching the network perimeter through malware
Data corruption caused by failed storage hardware
Unauthorized access resulting from misconfigured firewall rules

explanation: Die meisten Datenverluste entstehen nicht durch böswillige Absicht, sondern versehentlich bei der täglichen Arbeit — etwa beim Teilen von Dateien oder Kopieren von Inhalten. Genau hier setzt DLP an; Malware-Angriffe, Hardware-Defekte und Firewall-Fehlkonfigurationen sind keine DLP-Kernszenarien.

source.title: Understand the role of data loss prevention (DLP)
source.quote: Most data loss doesn't come from malicious intent. It happens during everyday work, when people share files, copy content, or use tools to make collaboration easier.

prompt: You're explaining to a colleague how Microsoft Purview DLP decides whether an activity puts data at risk. Which three signals does DLP evaluate together to make this decision? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.

options.text: Content, such as sensitive information types or labeled content
Context, such as where the data is stored or shared and who is involved
Action, such as sharing, copying, uploading, or pasting
The user's job title and seniority level
The age of the data and how long it has existed

explanation: DLP kombiniert drei Signale: Content (was die Daten sind), Context (wo/mit wem) und Action (was damit geschieht). Dieselben Daten können je nach Nutzung erlaubt oder eingeschränkt sein. Jobtitel und Datenalter sind keine der drei Bewertungssignale.

source.title: Understand how DLP applies protection
source.quote: DLP decisions are made by combining these signals. The same data might be allowed in one situation and restricted in another, depending on how it's used.

prompt: For each of the following statements about the capabilities of Microsoft Purview DLP, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

statements.text: DLP can apply actions like blocking, warning, or auditing risky behavior.
DLP can determine user intent on its own.
DLP can replace data classification and labeling strategies.

explanation: DLP soll Risiken reduzieren, nicht vollständig eliminieren: Es kann sensible Inhalte erkennen und Aktionen wie Blockieren, Warnen oder Auditieren anwenden. Es kann jedoch weder die Absicht eines Nutzers selbst bestimmen noch Klassifizierungs- und Labeling-Strategien ersetzen — es baut auf ihnen auf.

source.title: Understand the role of data loss prevention (DLP)
source.quote: DLP is designed to reduce risk, not eliminate it entirely.

prompt: Users in your organization share sensitive files in Microsoft Teams channels. You need to understand which DLP policies govern these files. Which statement is correct?

options.text: Files shared in Teams are governed by SharePoint and OneDrive policies, while Teams DLP evaluates chat and channel messages
Teams DLP evaluates both messages and all shared files directly
Files shared in Teams are only protected by Endpoint DLP policies
Files shared in Teams can't be protected by DLP and require sensitivity labels instead

explanation: In Microsoft Teams bewertet DLP Chat- und Kanalnachrichten, während in Teams geteilte Dateien über die SharePoint- und OneDrive-Richtlinien abgedeckt werden. Der Schutz ist also nicht an allen Orten identisch — ein wichtiger Punkt bei der Planung.

source.title: Understand how DLP applies protection
source.quote: For example, in Microsoft Teams, DLP evaluates chat and channel messages, while files shared in Teams are governed by SharePoint and OneDrive policies.

prompt: Complete the sentence by selecting the correct options.
textParts: In Microsoft Purview, a DLP policy simulation runs for up to
, and the simulation results are retained for

options.text: 7 days
15 days
30 days
15 days
30 days
90 days

explanation: Simulationen laufen bis zu 15 Tage, die Ergebnisse werden 30 Tage aufbewahrt. So lässt sich das Richtlinienverhalten über einen Zeitraum hinweg statt anhand einzelner Ereignisse beurteilen.

source.title: Understand DLP deployment and simulation mode
source.quote:
Simulations run for up to **15 days**
*   Results are retained for **30 days**

prompt: A user who normally accesses a limited set of sensitive files begins downloading large volumes of data and uploading content to unfamiliar cloud services over a short period. Your current content-based DLP policies either miss this pattern or would require overly strict rules for everyone. What is the most appropriate approach?

options.text: Use signal-based controls that adjust enforcement as behavior patterns change
Apply blocking actions to all users at all times to cover the risk
Add more sensitive information types to the existing content-based policy
Disable DLP for this user and monitor manually through audit logs

explanation: Hier steigt das Risiko durch das jüngste Verhalten, nicht durch die Daten selbst. Signalbasierte Kontrollen (z. B. Adaptive Protection) passen die Durchsetzung an, wenn das Risiko steigt, statt für alle Nutzer permanent dieselben Restriktionen anzuwenden. Pauschales Blockieren erzeugt Rauschen, mehr SITs adressieren das Verhaltensmuster nicht.

source.title: Evaluate advanced DLP controls for your environment
source.quote: Here, risk increases based on recent behavior rather than the data alone. Signal-based controls can adjust enforcement as patterns change, allowing policies to respond when risk rises instead of applying the same restrictions at all times.

prompt: Your organization is deploying its first DLP policies. Place the steps of the recommended rollout approach in the correct order.

items.text: Run policies in simulation to observe policy behavior
Refine scope and actions based on real activity
Introduce limited enforcement where confidence is high
Expand enforcement gradually as policies mature

explanation: Ein bedachter Rollout beginnt mit der Simulation, verfeinert dann Scope und Aktionen anhand realer Aktivität, führt begrenzte Durchsetzung dort ein, wo das Vertrauen hoch ist, und weitet die Durchsetzung schrittweise aus. Das minimiert Störungen und baut Vertrauen in die DLP-Kontrollen auf.

source.title: Understand DLP deployment and simulation mode
source.quote:
1.  Run policies in simulation to observe policy behavior
2.  Refine scope and actions based on real activity
3.  Introduce limited enforcement where confidence is high
4.  Expand enforcement gradually as policies mature

prompt: Your organization needs a DLP policy for a common, well-understood compliance scenario and needs to move quickly. Which starting point should you choose in Microsoft Purview?

options.text: Start with a prebuilt policy template
Build a custom policy from scratch
Export a policy from another tenant
Create the policy through the Power Platform admin center

explanation: Vorlagen eignen sich, wenn das Risikoszenario verbreitet und gut verstanden ist, es schnell gehen muss und Konsistenz wichtiger als Präzision ist. Custom Policies sind sinnvoll bei organisationsspezifischen Szenarien oder wenn sich die Richtlinie stark weiterentwickeln soll.

source.title: Choose a template or create a custom policy
source.quote:
Templates are useful when:

*   The risk scenario is common and well understood
*   You need to move quickly
*   Consistency matters more than precision

prompt: You're designing a Microsoft Purview DLP policy that needs different detection conditions and different responses for two separate scenarios. At which level are detection conditions defined?

options.text: At the rule level; a policy can contain multiple rules that are evaluated independently
At the policy level; all rules inherit the same detection conditions
At the location level; each workload defines the detection conditions
At the tenant level; detection conditions apply globally to all policies

explanation: Detection wird auf Regel-Ebene definiert, nicht auf Richtlinien-Ebene. Eine DLP-Richtlinie kann mehrere Regeln enthalten; jede Regel definiert eigene Erkennungsbedingungen und eigenes Antwortverhalten und wird unabhängig ausgewertet.

source.title: Define what the policy detects
source.quote: In Microsoft Purview, detection is defined at the **rule level**, not at the policy level. A data loss prevention (DLP) policy can contain one or more rules, and each rule defines its own detection conditions and response behavior.

prompt: Two DLP policies apply to the same Exchange location and target similar sensitive data. Policy A has a higher priority and audits sensitive data sharing. Policy B has a lower priority and blocks the same action. A user shares a matching document externally. What is the likely outcome?

options.text: The activity is audited but not blocked, because the first matching policy can control enforcement
The activity is blocked, because the most restrictive action always wins
Both policies apply, so the activity is audited and blocked simultaneously
Neither policy applies until the priority conflict is resolved by an administrator

explanation: DLP-Richtlinien werden in Prioritätsreihenfolge ausgewertet. Die erste passende Richtlinie kann das Enforcement-Ergebnis bestimmen — eine höher priorisierte Audit-Richtlinie kann daher verhindern, dass eine niedriger priorisierte Richtlinie dieselbe Aktion blockiert. "Most restrictive wins" gilt hier nicht (das ist das Verhalten von Power-Platform-Connector-Richtlinien).

source.title: Manage DLP policies
source.quote: For example, a high-priority policy that audits sensitive data sharing might prevent a lower-priority policy from blocking the same action, even if both policies target similar data.

prompt: Match each DLP enforcement category to its behavior.

right.text: Activity is logged without interrupting users
Users receive guidance but can continue their action

explanation: Audit protokolliert nur, Warn zeigt Hinweise ohne zu stoppen, Block with override erlaubt das Fortfahren mit Begründung, und Block verhindert die Aktion vollständig. Nicht jede Kategorie ist an jedem Ort verfügbar; Aktionen werden auf Regel-Ebene konfiguriert.

source.title: Define how the policy responds
source.quote:
**Audit**, where activity is logged without interrupting users
*   **Warn**, where users receive guidance but can continue their action
*   **Block with override**, where users can proceed with justification
*   **Block**, where the action is prevented entirely

prompt: For each of the following statements about DLP simulation mode in Microsoft Purview, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

statements.text: The policy mode (off, simulation, or enforcement) applies at the policy level, so all rules within a policy run under the same mode.
You can simulate one rule while enforcing another rule within the same policy.
While a policy runs in simulation mode, users might still see policy tips or guidance.

explanation: Der Modus gilt auf Richtlinien-Ebene, nicht pro Regel — alle Regeln laufen im selben Modus, einzelne Regeln lassen sich nicht getrennt simulieren/durchsetzen. Policy Tips können in der Simulation dennoch angezeigt werden, sodass sich auch die Nutzerreaktion auf Hinweise beobachten lässt.

source.title: Validate policy behavior using simulation mode
source.quote:
A DLP policy can be **off**, run in **simulation**, or run in **enforcement**, and the selected mode applies at the policy level, not per rule.

All rules within a policy run under the same mode. You can't simulate one rule while enforcing another.

prompt: An administrator wants to make changes to an existing, enforced DLP policy. For which three changes is cloning the policy safer than editing it directly? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.

options.text: Changing the intent of the policy
Introducing stricter enforcement
Expanding coverage to new locations or users
Refining detection conditions slightly
Updating notification recipients

explanation: Klonen ist sicherer bei Intent-Änderungen, strikterer Durchsetzung, Erweiterung auf neue Orte/Nutzer oder Paralleltests, weil das Originalverhalten erhalten bleibt und Änderungen unabhängig validiert werden können. Kleine Verfeinerungen der Erkennung oder Benachrichtigungs-Updates sind typische Fälle für direktes Bearbeiten.

source.title: Manage DLP policies
source.quote:
Cloning a policy is safer when:

*   Changing the intent of the policy
*   Introducing stricter enforcement
*   Expanding coverage to new locations or users
*   Testing a different approach in parallel

prompt: A DLP rule with Adaptive Protection warned a user last month when they attempted to copy a sensitive file. This week, the same rule blocks the same user performing the same action. The rule's detection conditions and scope haven't changed. What is the most likely explanation?

options.text: The user's insider risk level increased, so the same rule now produces a stricter enforcement outcome
The policy priority was automatically raised by Microsoft Purview
The sensitivity label on the file was upgraded, which always converts warnings into blocks
Simulation mode ended, and enforcement began automatically

explanation: Bei Adaptive Protection bleibt die Erkennung unverändert, aber das Enforcement passt sich dem Nutzerrisiko an. Steigt oder sinkt das Risiko, kann dieselbe Regel unterschiedliche Ergebnisse liefern — z. B. erst warnen, später blockieren —, ohne dass Detection oder Scope neu definiert werden.

source.title: Adjust enforcement dynamically based on risk
source.quote: User risk can change over time as behavior changes. When risk increases or decreases, the same rule can produce different enforcement outcomes without redefining detection or scope.

prompt: A DLP alert turns out to be a false positive caused by masked credit card numbers in a monthly report. You want to adjust the policy so this doesn't happen again. Which tool should you use?

options.text: Microsoft Purview
Microsoft Defender XDR
Microsoft Sentinel
Microsoft Entra ID

explanation: Beide Tools zeigen dieselben Alerts, dienen aber unterschiedlichen Zwecken: Microsoft Purview ist auf Compliance und die Richtlinie selbst fokussiert — was den Alert ausgelöst hat und ob die Regeln wie erwartet funktionieren. Bei False Positives passt man dort die Richtlinie an. Defender XDR dient der Korrelation mit anderen Sicherheitssignalen.

source.title: Understand data loss prevention (DLP) alerts
source.quote: **Microsoft Purview** is used for compliance. It focuses more on the policy itself: what triggered the alert, what rules were involved, and whether those rules are working as expected. If the alert came from a false positive, Purview is where you'd go to adjust the policy so it doesn't happen again.

prompt: Your organization is planning DLP alert configuration and reviewing licensing. For each of the following statements, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

statements.text: Single-event alerts are available with E1, F1, G1, E3, or G3 licenses.
Aggregate-event alerts require an E5 or G5 license, or an eligible add-on for E1/E3/G1/G3.
An E3 tenant without an add-on license uses a one-minute aggregation time window.

explanation: Single-Event-Alerts sind bereits mit E1/F1/G1/E3/G3 verfügbar; Aggregate-Event-Alerts erfordern E5/G5 oder ein passendes Add-on. Das Ein-Minuten-Aggregationsfenster gilt für E5 bzw. Add-on-Lizenzen — E3/G3 ohne Add-on nutzen ein 15-Minuten-Fenster.

source.title: Configure DLP policies to generate alerts
source.quote:
**Single-event alerts**: Available with E1, F1, G1, E3, or G3 licenses.
*   **Aggregate-event alerts**: Requires an E5 or G5 license, or one of the following add-ons for E1/E3/G1/G3

prompt: Place the stages of the DLP alert lifecycle in the correct order, from detection through resolution.

items.text: Trigger: a user's action matches a condition in a DLP policy
Notify: the alert appears in the portals and notifications are sent
Triage: review the alert, assign priority and an owner
Investigate: gather evidence and review activity logs
Remediate: take response actions based on the findings

explanation: Der DLP-Alert-Lebenszyklus folgt einem strukturierten Pfad: Trigger, Notify, Triage, Investigate, Remediate — und abschließend Tune, um die Richtlinie anhand der Erkenntnisse zu optimieren.

source.title: Understand the DLP alert lifecycle
source.quote: Data loss prevention (DLP) alerts follow a structured path from detection through resolution. Each stage has a specific purpose and a different set of decisions.

prompt: You deployed a new DLP policy with alerting enabled. For each of the following statements about how alerts behave after deployment, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

statements.text: It can take up to 3 hours for a new or updated policy to begin generating alerts.
If the same document triggers the same rule again within the aggregation window, a new separate alert is generated.
Policy matches on the same item in the same location are grouped if they occur within a one-minute window.

explanation: Neue oder geänderte Richtlinien können bis zu 3 Stunden brauchen, bevor sie Alerts erzeugen. Löst dasselbe Dokument dieselbe Regel innerhalb des Aggregationsfensters erneut aus, wird es in den bestehenden Alert gruppiert statt einen neuen zu erzeugen. Matches auf demselben Element am selben Ort werden innerhalb eines Ein-Minuten-Fensters gruppiert.

source.title: Configure DLP policies to generate alerts
source.quote:
If the same document triggers the same rule again within the aggregation window, it's grouped into the existing alert rather than generating a new one.
*   It can take up to 3 hours for a new or updated policy to begin generating alerts.

prompt: You're investigating DLP alerts. Match each tool to the investigation scenario where it's the best starting point.

right.text: See whether the alert is part of a broader pattern correlated across endpoints, email, identity, and cloud apps
Review the specific policy match, check the file content, and decide whether the policy needs tuning
Filter and compare user actions over time without opening individual alerts
Inspect the actual file or message content that triggered the match

explanation: Defender XDR korreliert DLP-Alerts mit Signalen aus Endpunkten, E-Mail, Identität und Cloud-Apps. Das Purview-Alerts-Dashboard eignet sich, wenn die auslösende Richtlinie bekannt ist und getunt werden soll. Activity Explorer vergleicht Nutzeraktionen über die Zeit, Content Explorer zeigt den tatsächlichen Inhalt.

source.title: Understand the DLP alert lifecycle
source.quote:
**Use Activity explorer** when you need to filter and compare user actions over time without opening individual alerts.
*   **Use Content explorer** when you need to inspect the actual file or message content that triggered the match.

prompt: Your organization deployed the Microsoft Purview DLP triage agent powered by Security Copilot. An analyst notices that alerts from a newly created DLP policy never appear in the Alert triage agent view. The policy is running in simulation mode. What is the cause?

options.text: The triage agent only triages alerts from active DLP policies; alerts from policies in simulation mode aren't included
The triage agent requires 30 days of alert history before processing a new policy
The triage agent only processes alerts from Exchange and SharePoint locations
The agent identity was not assigned the Compliance Administrator role

explanation: Der Triage-Agent verarbeitet nur Alerts aktiver DLP-Richtlinien — Richtlinien im Simulationsmodus sind ausgeschlossen. Weitere Einschränkungen: keine rein durch Custom SITs/Custom Trainable Classifiers ausgelösten Alerts, keine Dateien über 2 MB, keine Administrative-Unit-Scopes.

source.title: Investigate DLP alerts with Security Copilot and AI agents
source.quote: The agent only triages alerts from **active DLP policies**. Alerts from policies in **simulation mode** aren't included.

prompt: You're reviewing a matched event on the Events tab of a DLP alert in the Microsoft Purview Alerts dashboard. Which three actions are available from the Actions dropdown? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.

options.text: Apply or remove a sensitivity label
Unshare or delete the file
Send a notification email
Isolate the user's device
Reset the user's password

explanation: Im Actions-Dropdown des Events-Tabs in Purview stehen u. a. das Herunterladen des Inhalts, Anwenden/Entfernen eines Sensitivity Labels, Unshare/Delete der Datei, das Senden einer Benachrichtigungs-E-Mail und das Kopieren des Event-Links zur Verfügung. Geräteisolierung und Passwort-Reset sind Aktionen in Microsoft Defender XDR.

source.title: Investigate DLP alerts in Microsoft Purview
source.quote:
From the **Actions** dropdown, you can:

*   Download the matched content (requires appropriate role)
*   Apply or remove a sensitivity label (if permitted)
*   Unshare or delete the file
*   Send a notification email

prompt: What do data loss prevention (DLP) policies in Power Platform control?

options.text: Which connectors can work together, not what data flows through them
Which sensitive information types can be stored in Dataverse
Which content users can access within a SharePoint library
Which users are allowed to create flows and apps

explanation: Power-Platform-DLP-Richtlinien klassifizieren Connectors in Gruppen (Business, Non-Business, Blocked) und steuern, welche Connectors kombiniert werden dürfen — nicht, welche Daten durch sie fließen. Ein Business-gruppierter SharePoint-Connector kann weiterhin auf beliebige Inhalte zugreifen.

source.title: Configure data loss prevention policies for Power Platform
source.quote: DLP policies control which connectors can work together, not what data flows through them. For example, if the SharePoint Online connector is in the Business group, a user can still access any content in a SharePoint library.

prompt: Your organization uses DLP policies in Power Platform to govern connectors. For each of the following statements, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

statements.text: A connector can reside in only one group (Business, Non-Business, or Blocked) at a time.
When multiple policies apply to the same environment, the most restrictive combination of connector classifications takes effect.
A Power Platform DLP policy inspects the content of the data that flows between connectors.

explanation: Connectors können nur in genau einer Gruppe sein, und bei überlappenden Richtlinien in einer Umgebung gilt die restriktivste Kombination. Power-Platform-DLP prüft jedoch keine Dateninhalte — es steuert nur, welche Connectors miteinander kombiniert werden dürfen.

source.title: Configure data loss prevention policies for Power Platform
source.quote: Connectors can reside in only one group at a time. If you move SharePoint Online and a non-Microsoft connector into the Business group, users can't create flows or apps that combine those connectors with anything in the Non-Business or Blocked groups.

prompt: You need to create a DLP policy in the Power Platform admin center that prevents flows from bridging SharePoint data to unmanaged destinations. Place the policy creation steps in the correct order.

items.text: Assign connectors across the Business, Non-Business, and Blocked groups
Define Allow or Deny URL patterns for custom connectors
Define the policy scope by adding environments
Review all settings and create the policy

explanation: Der Assistent im Power Platform Admin Center folgt dieser Reihenfolge: Richtlinienname, Connector-Zuweisung (Business/Non-Business/Blocked), Custom-Connector-Patterns (Allow/Deny-URL-Muster), Scope-Definition über Umgebungen und abschließend Review und Erstellung.

source.title: Configure data loss prevention policies for Power Platform
source.quote: In Power Platform admin center, select **Policies**, select **Data policies**, and then select **+** **New policy**. Enter a policy name, and then select **Next**. On the **Assign Connectors** page, review the default connector classifications.

prompt: Your organization connected Box to Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps. You need to detect externally shared files containing financial data in Box and automatically quarantine them. Which approach should you use?

options.text: Create a file policy in the Microsoft Defender portal under Cloud Apps
Create a DLP policy in the Microsoft Purview portal scoped to the Instances location
Create a DLP policy in the Power Platform admin center and block the Box connector
Create a DLP policy in the Microsoft Purview portal scoped to the OneDrive location

explanation: Für Cloud-App-spezifische Governance-Aktionen wie Quarantäne oder das Widerrufen geteilter Links sind File Policies im Defender-Portal die richtige Wahl. Instances-basierte Purview-DLP-Richtlinien bieten zentrale Berichterstattung mit derselben Regel-Engine, aber die Quarantäne-Governance ist die Stärke der File Policies.

source.title: Integrate data loss prevention in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
source.quote: File policies offer cloud-app-specific governance like quarantine and link revocation. Purview DLP policies provide the same rule engine and reporting you use for Exchange and SharePoint.

prompt: Complete the sentence by selecting the correct options.
textParts: When creating a file policy in Defender for Cloud Apps, the
inspection method uses Defender for Cloud Apps content inspection capabilities, while the
uses the same sensitive information types and trainable classifiers you already manage in Microsoft Purview.

options.text: Built-in DLP
Data Classification Service
Exact data match
Built-in DLP
Data Classification Service
Content explorer

explanation: File Policies unterstützen zwei Inspektionsmethoden: Built-in DLP nutzt die Content-Inspection von Defender for Cloud Apps, der Data Classification Service greift auf die in Purview gepflegten SITs und Trainable Classifiers zu — so müssen keine zwei getrennten Regelsätze gepflegt werden.

source.title: Configure policies in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
source.quote:
**Built-in DLP** uses Defender for Cloud Apps content inspection capabilities.
*   **Data Classification Service** uses the same sensitive information types and trainable classifiers you already manage in Microsoft Purview.

prompt: Which three elements does a file policy in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps combine? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.

options.text: A content scan that identifies files matching sensitive information types or custom expressions
Context filters that narrow the scope based on metadata like sharing level, file owner, or app
Automated actions that define what happens when the conditions match
A connector group classification for Business and Non-Business data sources
A simulation window that delays enforcement for 15 days

explanation: Jede File Policy kombiniert drei Elemente: Content Scan (Erkennung sensibler Inhalte), Context Filter (Eingrenzung über Metadaten wie Sharing-Level) und Automated Actions (z. B. externen Zugriff widerrufen). Connector-Gruppen gehören zu Power Platform, ein 15-Tage-Simulationsfenster ist ein Purview-DLP-Konzept.

source.title: Configure policies in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
source.quote:
**Content scan** identifies files that match sensitive information types or custom expressions. In this case, credit card number patterns.
*   **Context filters** narrow the scope based on metadata like sharing level, file owner, or app.
*   **Automated actions** define what happens when both conditions match, such as revoking external access or sending an alert.

prompt: An administrator needs to create a tenant-level DLP policy in the Power Platform admin center. Which two permissions allow this? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.

options.text: Power Platform admin permissions
Microsoft 365 Global admin permissions
Power Apps Environment Admin permissions
Compliance Administrator role in Microsoft Purview

explanation: Tenant-weite Power-Platform-DLP-Richtlinien erfordern Power-Platform-Admin- oder Microsoft-365-Global-Admin-Berechtigungen. Power Apps Environment Admin reicht nur für Umgebungs-Richtlinien; die Purview-Compliance-Rollen gelten für Purview-DLP, nicht für Power Platform.

source.title: Configure data loss prevention policies for Power Platform
source.quote:
To follow these steps for tenant-level policies, you need one of the following permissions:

*   Power Platform admin permissions
*   Microsoft 365 Global admin permissions
